annotations.text: Mostly there already: the Mac reports focus to the server (reportClientActivity) and the server streams it (subscribeBackgroundPolicy). Missing pieces: the open thread as a scope, and a way to write into the Mac composer (today drafts live only in the Mac's localStorage).
Recommend 1A + 2A: the pill sits above the bar like a mini player, its mic talks straight into the Mac thread without opening anything; tapping the pill opens the remote.
Phase 2: the Live Activity gets Stop/Talk buttons, and a Control for the Action button opens straight into talking.
